summary: Compute in the lattice basis: the Gram matrix of the lattice basis is the standard one, and the vector is 0 ⊕ (x, −(ππ̄)⁻¹t) ⊕ 0.

steps.claim: Use gram_besselLatticeBasis (ππ̄ = N) to move the form back to the standard basis, where e becomes (0, (x, −(ππ̄)⁻¹t), 0).
steps.lean: simp [← gram_besselLatticeBasis π N hN, ← mulVec_mulVec, ← star_mulVec_dotProduct, tailVector]

steps.claim: Expand: ē·J·e = x̄x − N·|(ππ̄)⁻¹t|² = x̄x − (ππ̄)⁻¹tt̄ (as N = ππ̄ and (ππ̄)⁻¹ is self-conjugate), and the z-coordinate of J·e is t.
steps.lean: simp [besselLatticeBasis, splitGram, middleGram, entrywise]; grind [π.mul_inv, star_mul, star_one]
